sanskrit_verse: एकस्य चेत् स्याद् व्यसनं दायादोऽस्य तदाप्नुयात् । अन्यो वासति दायादे शक्ताश्चेत् सर्व एव वा ॥
transliteration: ekasya cet syād vyasanaṃ dāyādo 'sya tad āpnuyāt | anyo vāsati dāyāde śaktāś cet sarva eva vā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If ruin befalls one heir, that heir shall assume full consequence; if another resides in inheritance capacity and is empowered, all equally share the outcome.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in conscious capacity to sustain inheritance
Causation aligns with active residence and energetic participation
Restoration logic requires integration of loss through conscious assumption
Consciousness alignment mandates shared liability when empowerment is mutual
executable_legal_axioms: IF heir A experiences collapse AND resides within inheritance domain THEN A assumes total consequence.
IF heir B resides in inheritance domain AND holds equal conscious capacity THEN B shares consequence equally.
IF multiple heirs hold conscious capacity THEN consequence distribution is proportionate to energetic engagement.
IF no heir maintains conscious capacity THEN inheritance dissolves without punitive assignment.
supreme_court_application: In matters involving estate dissolution or financial collapse, the Supreme Court must assess not ownership records alone, but the living presence and energetic capacity of each potential heir. Responsibility flows from actualized consciousness, not nominal designation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals causality through conscious inhabitation, not abstract title. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how collapse manifests sequentially based on energetic engagement. Responsibility is proportional to lived capacity. No suffering arises as deterrent—only completion occurs through conscious reintegration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate heir-consciousness audit to determine energetic presence in inheritance field
Activate consequence-assumption protocol for residing and empowered heirs
Deploy collective integrity restoration if all heirs demonstrate mutual capacity
Dissolve inheritance cleanly if no conscious holder remains
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure consciousness alignment. No punishment arises—only completion. Reality responds to conscious capacity. Dharma is restored.
